section: Social Studies (Paper-2) · Ch49 — Andhra Pradesh — Deep 2
subject: Social Studies
stem: The state of Andhra Pradesh was bifurcated to create the new state of Telangana in the year:
explanation: Telangana was carved out of Andhra Pradesh on 2 June 2014, under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 — making it India's 29th state at the time.

section: Social Studies (Paper-2) · Ch49 — Andhra Pradesh — Deep 2
subject: Social Studies
stem: The Srisailam Dam, an important multi-purpose dam and hydroelectric project in Andhra Pradesh, is built across which river?
explanation: Srisailam Dam is built across the Krishna river, serving irrigation, hydroelectric power generation, and situated near the Srisailam Wildlife Sanctuary.
